name: – Emma Ytterell – Article 5, § 1 – Am 39
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1. Changes or extensions of projects to ensure decarbonisation or reduction of emissions, shall only be subject to screening by the competent authorities in order to determine if they are likely to have significant effects on the environment, as defined in Directive 2011/92/EU. Where such changes or extensions are likely to have significant effects on the environment, they shall be subject to an environmental assessment.
